text: {"label":"Treatment Relapse and Its Mitigation","definition":"Basic, translational, and applied research on the return of behavior after successful treatment, covering its prevalence, laboratory models, theoretical accounts, and practical strategies for making behavioral treatments more durable.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Addresses relapse broadly across forms and mitigation strategies, unlike the neighbouring topic on resurgence and renewal paradigms, general treatment integrity and acceptability, or substance abuse and addiction."}
